summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on the integration of Spark features and the resolution of license issues blocking the 1.11 and 1.10.2 releases. Additionally, there are ongoing proposals related to the v4 specification, including partition management and access policies.
highlights: License issues blocking Iceberg 1.11 and 1.10.2 releases resolved
Managing partition tuples in Iceberg v4
Proposal for fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable
